summary: Frontend-only verification of Hot Live 95 StationsModal (Broadcast Center) restructured layout + new Loudness Target control + VU meter clip/dB readout. License bypass applied via localStorage. Broadcast Center opens from header go-live-button and renders ALL required elements: broadcast-golive-all, broadcast-hotkey-hint (Ctrl+Shift+L), broadcast-stop-all, loudness-control wrapper, loudness-target select, broadcast-meta-format select, broadcast-level containing vu-meter with vu-clip (round light) and vu-db (shows '-∞dB' idle). Loudness persistence verified: defaults to 'Off', change to '-14' persists after closing+reopening the modal, change back to 'Off' also persists. Zero page errors. The only console error is a pre-existing React DOM nesting warning (<span> inside <option> in the bitrate select) unrelated to this change. Electron-only restore prompt and listener peak alert correctly do not appear in the browser preview and cause no errors.
